## Summary

Describe the user-visible or acoustic behavior changed.

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `acoustic-agent verify-resources --hashes`
- [ ] Seeded output changes are tested or explained
- [ ] Accuracy and performance are reported separately where relevant
- [ ] Documentation and resource notices are updated where relevant

## Solver Notes

For solver changes, report the affected direct path, diffraction, reflection,
decay, FDN, portal, HRTF, or motion components and the validation tolerance.
